name: COSCO SHIPPING International (Singapore) Co., Ltd.
summary: COSCO SHIPPING International (Singapore) Co., Ltd., an investment holding company, provides integrated logistics services in South and Southeast Asia. It operates through Shipping, Ship Repair and Marine Engineering Activities, Logistics, and Property Management segments. The company provides warehousing solutions, including crating and packing cross-docking emergency parts distribution knitting and co-packing services labeling and tagging light manufacturing pick and pack, labeling, fulfillment, delivery purchase order management re-work receiving and inventory replenishment sorting, and segregating stock transfer.
